long_biography.plain_text:
A shift from securities holding to consumer-goods commerce reshaped the Madrid company that became T Box Import. Marjolein Ingeborg Piet joined its board in 2006 as a director and joint managing director while it adopted a broad import, retail and exclusive-brand representation mandate.

The business simplified its governance in 2007 by replacing the board with two joint administrators. Piet continued in the new structure alongside Alberto Novales Martínez, moving from collective board responsibility to direct administrative authority. The company later established its registered base in Alcobendas, where its filings continued under the T Box Import name.
